cohort: The study included 54,593 patients who underwent C-sections, drawn from the National Surgical Quality Improvement Project database between 2012 and 2022.
finding: Machine learning models, particularly Random Forests, effectively predict 30-day C-section readmissions using demographic, preoperative, and perioperative data, with key predictors including age, BMI, operative time, white blood cell count, and hematocrit.
mod_finding: The study identified operative time as a key predictor for 30-day C-section readmissions among patients undergoing this mode of birth.
country: USA (inferred from National Surgical Quality Improvement Project and 'nationwide analysis')
